Path_218521 shows that Kazinol J targets Elongation factor 1-alpha 2, which is targeted by (1S)-2-Cyclohexen-1-ol, and this compound also targets the same gene. Both pathways converge on the Macrophage-expressed gene 1 protein, suggesting a potential mechanism by which Kazinol J influences its expression. The evidence is consistent with a regulatory relationship, where Kazinol J may act as a modulator of the downstream targets, possibly through the activation or inhibition of the signaling pathways involving citrusinol and (1S)-2-Cyclohexen-1-ol. The final scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, but further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct involvement of Kazinol J in the regulation of the Macrophage-expressed gene 1 protein.
